category: shared seedbox with a permanent free tier

free_tier.stated: 'Need free seedbox? Try out our free limited feature seedbox.' Plan card: 'Sonicers Free 4 GB - FREE - Once you be a Sonicers, you will be credited 4 GB Storage. You can always upgrade anytime.'
free_tier.notes: the only permanent free seedbox tier found; 4 GB, not a trial

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable; the free tier is capped at 4 GB total, which is smaller than most single video files

retention.stated: while the account exists; 'limited feature' is not defined further and no inactivity deletion is stated

egress.terms: 'Unlimited traffic, 10 GBPS Network, for as low as 2.15 Dollar'; torrents are converted to direct HTTP links ('Download converted torrent file by HTTP direct download link provides for you'). No byte allowance is published for any tier.
egress.free_allowance: unlimited claimed, on a 4 GB free tier

interface_detail: Retrieval is over generated HTTP direct-download links from the dashboard; remote upload pushes to Google Drive, OneDrive, DropBox and pCloud. No SFTP or FTP is named on the page.
tooling: Browser dashboard and HTTP direct links; remote upload to Google Drive/OneDrive/DropBox/pCloud; no CLI or API documented
chaining: A free 4 GB landing pad that turns a magnet into an HTTP link

limits.value: 4 GB total storage on the free tier; a single file larger than the tier cannot be held

limits_note: The 4 GB storage is the binding fact and the vocabulary has no kind for total disk; it is filed as per-object-cap because on this tier object and total coincide.
binding_note: 4 GB holds nothing of value at 1 TiB/month; the free tier is a pipeline test, not capacity.

identity_cost.detail: A dashboard account ('Once you be a Sonicers') is required; no phone or document check is stated for the free tier.

reliability_note: The free tier is 'limited feature' without a definition, so what is disabled is discovered at signup; nothing is charged, so nothing is refunded either.
confidence_note: The free tier and its 4 GB are stated on the vendor's own home page read. A measured rung needs an account and a real transfer.

evidence.proved: 'Sonicers Free 4 GB FREE'; 'Unlimited traffic, 10 GBPS Network, for as low as 2.15 Dollar'; 'Download converted torrent file by HTTP direct download link'; paid tiers USD 3.95/50 GB, 5.95/100 GB, 10.95/350 GB

price_per_tb_month: USD 0 for 4 GB; paid Basic USD 5.95 for 100 GB = USD 59.50/TB/month

extras.minimum_term: free tier permanent; paid tiers monthly
extras.apps: browser dashboard, torrent-to-HTTP conversion, remote upload to Google Drive/OneDrive/DropBox/pCloud
extras.trial_card_required: no card for the free tier
extras.trial_restock: free tier is standing, not restocked
